description: Assessment is an independent validator's bounded completion judgment.

validation_passed.description: ValidationPassed is true when the current outcome holds at 90–95% completion with no substantial gap.

observed.description: Observed states what the validator personally inspected or ran.

substantial_gaps.description: SubstantialGaps lists unmet requirements that justify another task in this outcome.

small_gaps.description: SmallGaps lists optional finishing work that must not block this outcome or the next.
